node: Midstream compression, flow control, and LNG-adjacent equipment
summary: Expanded the universe around midstream gas compression, flow-control equipment, and LNG-adjacent cryogenic/process equipment. The underfollowed lane is strongest in contract-compression operators whose economics are tied to utilization, horsepower deployment, fixed-revenue contracts, and midstream/LNG/power-demand pull rather than direct commodity ownership. Flow-control and cryogenic-equipment names provide context for the equipment side, but Chart Industries is now partly event-driven because of the pending Baker Hughes acquisition.
